questions.prompt_html: \int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}+1} \text{ 的值为[ ].}

options.label: A
options.html: \arccos x + \frac { 1 - \sqrt { 1 - x ^ { 2 } } } { x } + C

options.label: B
options.html: \arcsin x + \frac { 1 - \sqrt { 1 - x ^ { 2 } } } { x } + C

options.label: C
options.html: \arcsin x - { \frac { 1 - { \sqrt { 1 - x ^ { 2 } } } } { x } } + C

options.label: D
options.html: \arccos x - \frac { 1 - \sqrt { 1 - x ^ { 2 } } } { x } + C

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解答 令} & x=\sin t(-\frac{\pi}{2}<t<\frac{\pi}{2}),\ \text{则} \ dx=\cos t \, dt\ ,\ \ \cos t=\sqrt{1-x^{2}}\\ \text{于是} & \int\frac{dx}{\sqrt{1-x^{2}}+1}=\int\frac{\cos t}{1+\cos t}\, dt=\int\frac{1+\cos t-1}{1+\cos t}\, dt=\int(1-\frac{1}{2\cos^{2}(\frac{t}{2})})\, dt\\ & =t-\int \sec^{2}\frac{t}{2}\, d(\frac{t}{2})=t-\tan\frac{t}{2}+C\\ \text{又有} & \tan\frac{t}{2}=\frac{1-\cos t}{\sin t}=\frac{1-\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}{x}\ ,\ \text{所以原式}=\arcsin x-\frac{1-\sqrt{1-x^{2}}}{x}+C\end{aligned}

options.html: \ln | 1 + x | + \frac { 2 } { x + 1 } + \frac { 3 } { 2 } \cdot \frac { 1 } { ( 1 + x ) ^ { 2 } } + C \, ;

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解答 令 } x+1&=t,\ \text{则 } x=t-1 \text{ 于是} \int \frac{x^{2}+2}{(x+1)^{3}}\,dx&=\int \frac{(t-1)^{2}+2}{t^{3}}\,dt \\ &=\int (\frac{1}{t}-\frac{2}{t^{2}}+\frac{3}{t^{3}})dt&=\ln |t|+\frac{2}{t}-\frac{3}{2t^{2}}+C \\ &=\ln |t+x|+\frac{2}{x+1}-\frac{3}{2}\cdot \frac{1}{(1+x)^{2}}+C\,. \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解答 令}\sqrt{x}&=t\ ,\ \text{则}x=t^{2}\ \text{于是}\int\frac{x}{\sqrt{x+1}}dx=\int\frac{t^{2}}{1+t}\cdot 2tdt=2\int\frac{(t^{3}+1)-1}{1+t}dt\\&=2\int(t^{2}-t+1-\frac{1}{1+t})dt=2(\frac{1}{3}t^{3}-\frac{1}{2}t^{2}+t-\ln|1+t|)+C\\&=\frac{2}{3}x\sqrt{x}-x+2\sqrt{x}-2\ln|1+\sqrt{x}|\!+\!C\,.\end{aligned}
